high.title: Luhut Signals Strong Indication Customs Functions Will Be Taken Over by DSI
high.summary: Key government official Luhut Pandjaitan indicates that some Customs functions may be transferred to the new state export company DSI, with AI-based digital systems replacing traditional customs processes. This represents a major restructuring of Indonesia's trade infrastructure that could significantly impact export procedures and government revenue collection.

high.title: Finance Minister Discovers 10 Palm Oil Companies Manipulating Exports, Sold Cheap to Singapore
high.summary: Finance Minister Purbaya reveals that all 10 largest palm oil exporters are conducting under-invoicing practices, causing estimated state losses of US$84 million from just a small sample. This massive tax evasion scheme could result in much larger losses and may trigger major enforcement actions against Indonesia's key export sector.

high.title: US Dollar Nearly Reaches Rp 17,800, Purbaya: 'Doesn't Make Sense'
high.summary: The rupiah weakened to nearly Rp 17,800 per US dollar, with Finance Minister Purbaya calling the decline 'unreasonable' given Indonesia's strong economic fundamentals. This significant currency weakness poses risks to inflation, import costs, and overall economic stability despite positive GDP growth.

high.title: IHSG Battered, OJK Chief Guarantees Indonesia Investment Prospects Still Good
high.summary: OJK Chairman acknowledges the Jakarta Composite Index is under correction due to global challenges but maintains that Indonesia's long-term investment prospects remain positive. The statement comes amid market volatility and attempts to restore investor confidence in Indonesian capital markets.

high.title: 4 Indonesian Stocks Kicked Out by FTSE Russell, BEI Chief: Consequence of Capital Market Reform
high.summary: FTSE Russell removes four Indonesian stocks from its Global Equity Index due to high shareholding concentration and insufficient free float. This delisting has triggered foreign investor selling pressure on IHSG but is viewed as a short-term consequence of ongoing capital market reforms.

medium.title: Danantara Responds to S&P and Moody's About One-Stop Export Risks Through DSI
medium.summary: Danantara's COO responds to warnings from credit rating agencies S&P and Moody's about risks from the new one-stop export policy through DSI. The rating agencies warn this centralized approach could harm exports, reduce government revenue, and negatively impact Indonesia's credit rating.

medium.title: Trade Minister Speaks on Alfamart and Indomaret Closures in Lombok
medium.summary: Trade Minister clarifies that minimarket closures in Central Lombok are due to licensing issues and spatial planning compliance, not other factors. This indicates ongoing regulatory enforcement that could affect retail expansion strategies in certain regions.

medium.title: IHSG Closes Strong at Week's Start
medium.summary: Jakarta Composite Index gained 0.72% to close at 6,206.34 points with trading turnover reaching Rp 16.95 trillion. The positive performance provides some relief amid recent market volatility and reform-related pressures.

medium.title: BEI Will Meet Global Index Providers Again
medium.summary: Indonesia Stock Exchange will hold follow-up meetings with global index providers like MSCI and FTSE Russell as part of ongoing capital market reforms. These discussions are crucial for maintaining Indonesia's position in global indices and attracting foreign investment.

medium.title: Purbaya Dismisses 5.61% Economic Growth as 'Just on Paper', Car Sales Rise, Malls Busy
medium.summary: Finance Minister defends Q1 2026 economic growth of 5.61% as genuine, citing real indicators like increased car sales and busy shopping centers. The statement addresses skepticism about economic data and reinforces confidence in Indonesia's economic recovery.

medium.title: Beware New Fraud Schemes Offering Profits from Guessing Pictures, Watching Chinese Dramas
medium.summary: Financial authorities shut down five entities involved in new investment scam schemes that promise returns from simple daily activities. This highlights the evolving nature of financial fraud targeting Indonesian investors through increasingly creative methods.

medium.title: Antam Gold Price Today Falls Rp 13,000 per Gram
medium.summary: Antam 24-karat gold price dropped Rp 13,000 to Rp 2,785,000 per gram, reflecting global gold market movements. This price adjustment affects investment returns for gold investors and indicates shifting precious metals demand.

medium.title: Buying Sacrificial Animals Subject to Tax? Here's What DJP Says
medium.summary: Tax authorities confirm that sacrificial animal transactions are exempt from VAT ahead of Eid al-Adha. This tax exemption supports religious practices and reduces costs for consumers during the important Islamic holiday.

medium.title: VKTR Delivers 30 Electric Buses to TransJakarta in Q1
medium.summary: Electric vehicle company VKTR recorded 823% growth in operating profit and 58% revenue growth, driven by strong demand for commercial electric vehicles. The company's performance reflects Indonesia's transition toward electric transportation and sustainable mobility solutions.

medium.title: Sukuk ST016 Officially Launched, Sharia Investment Starting Rp 1 Million on BRImo
medium.summary: New Islamic government bonds ST016 launched with minimum investment of Rp 1 million, targeting growing sharia investment demand. With sharia capital market capitalization reaching Rp 8,900 trillion, this expands access to compliant investment instruments for Indonesian Muslims.
